ideas.pitch: An LLM-assisted blue team log analysis tool that parses system and web server logs in real time to automatically reconstruct attack paths and flag anomalous requests.
ideas.title: LogSleuth AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a defense-in-depth approach inspired by winning security agents, directly helping blue teams win through rapid triage and clear attack reconstruction on the live leaderboard.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local reverse proxy designed for the blue team to monitor incoming requests, detect automated scanning patterns, and drop malicious traffic without disrupting legitimate lab traffic.
ideas.title: FlagGuard Web Proxy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the rule restrictions against automated exploitation frameworks by giving defenders real-time visibility into traffic anomalies and scanner signatures.

ideas.pitch: A tactical offensive helper tool for red teams to quickly assemble, encode, and test specific payload variations against designated lab web applications within the competition rules.
ideas.title: PayloadForge CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides genuine engineering utility for red teamers who need to iterate rapidly under strict time constraints without using forbidden automated scanners.

ideas.pitch: A local collaboration and flag submission tracker for red and blue teams that parses target status, maps discovered vulnerabilities, and coordinates internal team strategy securely.
ideas.title: RedDash Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the logistical overhead of attack-and-defense competitions where team communication is restricted and execution speed decides the live leaderboard ranking.

ideas.pitch: A rapid code-auditing companion that inspects target web applications before or during the match to highlight hidden logic flaws and hardcoded endpoints for flag hunting.
ideas.title: SecAudit Diff
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines static analysis insights with fast tactical execution, mirroring the report-generation and vulnerability-insight patterns seen in hackathon winners.
